housing-numbers.notes: Plan aims to deliver at least 6,405 new homes over plan period 2016-2031 (427 homes per annum). Housing distributed as: Sutton Town Centre 55% (c3,400), Hackbridge 15% (c1,100), Wallington 10% (c635), Other District Centres 10% (c635), Suburban Heartlands 10% (c635). Specific breakdown of allocated vs windfall vs committed not clearly stated in document.
